title: Batch 75 · Coverage from product surfaces
note: From a live survey of ChatGPT's icon sprite (854 symbols, 426 concepts), Notion's loaded icon set (206 concepts) and Figma's editor bundle (743 24px icons, read by eye). Each icon here is used in at least one of the three; most in two.

icons.name: image-sparkle
icons.label: Create image
icons.spec: square; ChatGPT photo-sparkle (Create image), Figma's AI image actions, Fluent image_sparkle: image's frame and mountain copied exactly, the sun replaced by chat-sparkle's corner sparkle (±2.5, Q 0.3) set in to 11, 5.5 so its foot sits 2.12 from the mountain's slope (detail 1.0 in the outline; filled, its halo meets the mountain's cut, no sliver). The frame is cut round the sparkle by the overlap cut (top to 8.806, right from 7.798). Filled: the frame fills, closing on a chord between the sparkle's top and right tips inside its halo (the rounded corner left an island); the mountain stays a cut and the sparkle ink with a halo (chat-sparkle's).

icons.name: pencil-sparkle
icons.label: Edit with AI
icons.spec: square; ChatGPT pencil-sparkle: the slim pencil (2.12 wide, sides on x + y = 14.5 / 17.5, the composites' pen body with pencil's square r 0.5 end and its band 2.12 below the end) with the ±2.5 sparkle at 4.5, 4.5, detail 1.0 from the pencil's side. The full-width pencil left the sparkle 1.77 away or pushed the ink to 13.4 wide. Filled: pencil and sparkle solid, the band a cut.

icons.name: text-sparkle
icons.label: Write with AI
icons.spec: square; Figma's AI text actions (lines with a sparkle): three text lines on pixel centres (6.5 to 7.5, 9.5 to 13.5, 12.5 to 10.5) with chat-sparkle's corner sparkle at 11.5, 4.5; the short top line ends a tight 2.5 from the sparkle's left tip and the sparkle's foot is 2.5 above the middle line. Ink centre sits 0.75 high (the sparkle is the top). Filled: the sparkle solid, the lines unchanged.

icons.name: code-sparkle
icons.label: Generate code
icons.spec: horizontal; Figma's code-sparkle: code's chevrons copied exactly with the ±2.5 sparkle in place of the slash, centred on 8, 8, tight 1.35 from both chevrons. Filled: the sparkle solid, the chevrons unchanged.

icons.name: people-group
icons.label: Group
icons.spec: circle; ChatGPT person-group, Figma's multiplayer avatars, Fluent people_team, Phosphor users-three: a front figure centred (head r 2 at 8, 6.5; body 5 to 11 from 11 to 14, r 2.5 shoulders) with two back figures (head r 1.5 at 3.5 / 12.5, 4.5; a 4-wide dome 8.5 to 12) cut by the overlap cut round the front figure (people's construction, mirrored). Back bodies sit 0.5 lower than first drawn so the front head clears them by a detail 0.9. Filled: the front figure solid with a halo, the back figures fill (people's).

icons.name: person-dashed
icons.label: Unassigned
icons.spec: circle; Notion personCropCircleDashed (unassigned) and Figma's dashed person: person-circle's figure exactly (head r 2 at 8, 6.5; the body closing on the ring) inside circle-dashed's ring turned 22.5° so no dash meets the body; the two dashes beside the body sit at 21° / 159° (1.5° up) to clear its shoulders by a detail 0.98, the others at 45° steps. Six dashes of 15.2°. Filled: head and body solid, the dashes unchanged.

icons.name: circle-dollar
icons.label: Pricing
icons.spec: circle; ChatGPT dollarsign-circle, Figma's billing $, Lucide circle-dollar-sign: the ring with a $ sized for it, an S of two 2 × 1.5 elliptical bowls (6 to 10, 5 to 11, dollar's start and end angles) and ticks 4 to 5 and 11 to 12, detail 0.88 from the ring. Filled: the ring fills and the $ is a knockout (the ring's marks).

icons.name: chat-pen
icons.label: Edit comment
icons.spec: square; ChatGPT pencil-and-chat-bubble, Notion commentPencil, Fluent comment_edit: chat's bubble opened round compose's slim pen by the overlap cut (top to 6.818, right from 5.168), the pen shortened 0.75 along its axis and moved 0.5 left and 1.5 up so its tip sits 2.5 from the bubble's left and bottom. Filled: the pen solid, the bubble a line (compose's).

icons.name: sun-moon
icons.label: System theme
icons.spec: circle; ChatGPT moon-sun (theme), Lucide sun-moon: moon at half size (r 3, bite facing up and right) with sun's rays on the left half only (top, bottom, left and the two left diagonals), detail 0.88 from the moon, the whole moved 1 right so the ink centre is 7.44 (+2 put it at 8.5; the diagonal rays need whole shifts). Filled: the moon solid.

icons.name: heading-4
icons.label: Heading 4
icons.spec: horizontal; Figma H4, Notion heading 4: heading-1's H exactly with an open 4 (Lucide's): left stem 11 from 6.5 to 9, r 0.5 into the bar at 9.5 to 14.5, the full stem 13.5 from 6.5 to 12.5. The stems sit 2.5 apart: at 2 the filled lines left a hairline.

icons.name: heading-5
icons.label: Heading 5
icons.spec: horizontal; Figma H5: heading-1's H exactly with a 5: top bar 14 to 11.5 at 6.5, the stem down to 9.5 and heading-3's lower bowl (r 1.5) moved 0.5 left, centre 12.5, 11.

icons.name: heading-6
icons.label: Heading 6
icons.spec: horizontal; Figma H6: heading-1's H exactly with a 6: a ⌀3 bowl at 13, 11 (heading-3's bowl size) and a tail from 13.5, 6.5 on an r 6.06 arc tangent to the bowl's left side.

icons.name: pilcrow-right
icons.label: Left-to-right text
icons.spec: square; Figma's paragraph direction, Lucide pilcrow-right: pilcrow at a shorter height (stems 6.5 and 9.5 from 2.5 to 8.5, an r 2 bowl, the top bar to 10.5) over a standalone-style arrow 2.5 to 13.5 at 12.5 with a 2px head. The pilcrow sits 1 left so the head's top barb is 2.83 from the right stem. The bowl's closing edge lies on the stem, as in pilcrow. Filled: the bowl solid.

icons.name: pilcrow-left
icons.label: Right-to-left text
icons.spec: square; Lucide pilcrow-left: pilcrow-right's pilcrow moved 3 right (not mirrored: a pilcrow doesn't turn) over the arrow pointing left. Filled: the bowl solid.

extra: rectangle-vertical is a new turn of rectangle (transpose; ChatGPT rectangle-portrait / aspect 9:16, Notion rectangleTall). Not drawn: trash-restore (ChatGPT trash-open-arrow-up): every lattice placement of a restore arrow in the trash body lands between gap steps against the handle's feet (3.54 between centre-lines). folder-user (ChatGPT folder-person): a corner figure is taller than the folder's keyline allows, and a figure inside reads as a camera. Both are in docs/research/icon-review/2026-10-10/README.md (Batch 75) with options.
